description: The view from the flat (27th floor, Tel Aviv). city-pano.jpg: bearings -159.5..+40 (south-west over the business district, north-west, north to north-east), 4096 x 1024, rows linear in tan(elevation) from +0.6 (top) to -0.42 (bottom), stitched as a cylinder from the 1 fps-ish frames (0.1 s steps, 1470 px focal length) of Mark's balcony pan video; the stone neighbour tower is taken out of it (it is a 3D box) and its columns filled with pieces of the city next to it; the glass tower's top given a clean roof line. city-fill.jpg: the rest of the circle (east, south: not in the video, behind the building) put together from other pieces of the same panorama, some scaled down as more distant tower clusters, never mirrored. *-alpha.jpg: their skyline masks. facade-atlas.jpg (+ alpha, + facade-atlas.json = the rects): the neighbour tower's south-east face rectified from the panorama onto its plane (23.4 m from the balcony, 3.10 m floors; one continuous face, the floors evened out, its lower storeys whole floors of it, the part above the frames whole floors copied up), its lobby and our own balcony stack (self-made), the last floors above the panorama's bottom edge of the glass tower, Electra and the construction tower (carried down to the street in 3D), and the long low roof south-west projected from the pan's first second onto its roof plane. The ground, the park, the streets and the low-rise blocks are generated at runtime (src/scene/outsideCity.ts: canvas painting + vertex-coloured geometry, no image files); their layout follows Mark's description of the area (park east and north-east, offices west, a long low building south, low-rise to the north) and the pan, no map imagery.
source: Mark's own video sources/new house full/view/20261007_173837.mp4 (frames, stitching, rectification and projection by Claude); the rest self-made
